inferred_links.I1: Resolved by review RVN-01 (evidence key 'gate'). The load-context flag +0x2c gates every post-read step, not only the note limits: note limits, MidiNotes post-load (ids, next id, orphans, per-note list step, zero ids), store and list post-loads. The reviewer established that it is set for Live Set reads. Spec assumption A1 should be widened accordingly and marked established; PRB-S7-03 remains a reference check.
inferred_links.I2: Opening a Live Set and saving it without other changes alters the notes only by the released rules. Spec assumption A2 restated for an open-save of a set instead of placing a clip file (PRB-S7-09).
inferred_links.I3: A refusal raised while the notes are read stops the reading of the document; the catch site is untraced. What remains open is excluded (REQ-017 U); the comparison convention accepts a set not opened or opened without the clip. The transport-state-v1 review accepted the same inference for other read errors.
inferred_links.I4: A carrier set holding only the elements on the path to the clip, and the clip's Loop, reads the clip's notes as a full set would; the reference obligation embeds the notes element in a full set.
inferred_links.I5: strtod is correctly rounded and the save formatter prints exact binary values (accepted in the transport-state-v1 review); no case value lies on a tie or near a power of ten.
inferred_links.I6: gzip of the fixtures' form is decompressed in the standard way (als-container-v1 RVA-09, accepted).
inferred_links.I7: MidiKey, CC and the Id attributes are read by the int parser 0x1002fd908, whose converter 0x1002fda78 is from_chars-shaped and accepts a leading '-' (CC -2, -1, -3); every shipped clip with per-note lists carries CC -1 or -2 text.
